subject: Sales discovery: Legal routing & procurement next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@datawave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sales discovery: Legal routing & procurement next steps

Hi Alex — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from today's discovery: 

Summary from call:
- DataWave primary use case: document summarization and search across internal product docs (approx. 50M tokens/day expected after Q4).
- Key success criteria: sub-200ms p95 for short queries, SOC2-compliant data handling, flexible routing between hosted/dedicated.
- Budget signal: early-stage POC with potential expansion to dedicated capacity if latency/cost targets are met.

Stakeholders we captured:
- Alex Johnson (you) — Product lead / economic buyer for the POC
- Michael Lee (CTO) — security & infra owner (said he'd loop in legal/procurement)
- Procurement inbox (procurement@datawave.com) — indicated a standard SOW/MSA flow

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Legal/procurement routing: who owns NDAs / MSAs on your side? Please share the contact (name + email) so we can route the right templates.
2) Decision criteria doc: I'll send a short one-page doc summarizing performance, pricing, and security checklist for Michael and procurement.
3) Timeline: could you confirm target timeline for procurement review (e.g., target sign-off week)?

I've attached our standard NDA and a draft SOW for the POC to speed things up. Proposed legal sequence: NDA -> DPA (if scoped) -> MSA/SOW redlines. Typical turnaround we see for mid-market procurement/legal: 3-7 business days per review cycle. We're happy to prioritize NDA first so engineering can start provisioning.

Thanks — I'll follow up with a one-pager and add the proposed routing map.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood_NDA.pdf (stub), DataWave_SOW_v1.pdf (stub)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@datawave.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: Legal routing & procurement next steps

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap — that aligns with our notes. 

On legal routing: Procurement handles routing for standard MSAs but NDAs come from security/legal. I'll introduce you to the two folks: 
- Sarah Park (Legal Counsel) — sarah.park@datawave.com
- procurement@datawave.com (procurement inbox)

Timeline: procurement is aiming for an internal review by the week of Jul 19 for vendor POCs. Sarah indicated she can prioritize an NDA within 2-3 business days once we have a clean template. For MSA/SOW redlines she asked for sequencing (NDA first, then MSA + SOW).

Two quick Qs: 
1) Can you confirm the DPIA / data handling summary (we need that for our security review)?
2) Do you have a standard SOC2 evidence package or a link to where we can pull it?

Happy to be on a quick sync next week with Sarah and procurement to walk through the SOW and timelines.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Product Lead, Integrations | DataWave
alex.johnson@datawave.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@datawave.com>
Cc: Sarah Park <sarah.park@datawave.com>, procurement@datawave.com, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: Legal routing & procurement next steps

Alex / Sarah / procurement team — thanks for the quick replies. Looping Sarah here per Alex's intro. 

Answers to your questions: 
- DPIA / Data handling summary: attached one-page summary (embedded below) — covers data residency, encryption at-rest/in-flight, deletion policies, and KV-prefix caching notes we discussed. If you need a separate DPIA doc we can pull from our compliance team.
- SOC2 evidence: we have a SOC2 Type II report and an evidence portal (read-only links) that we can provide to named reviewers under an NDA. I've included the HUBSPOT deal link to track access.

Proposed legal sequencing and turn times: 
1) NDA (Redwood template) — target 1-3 business days for review (Sarah indicated this is typical). We can also countersign if you have a standard NDA.
2) DPA (if required based on data scope) — run in parallel with MSA redlines, target 3-7 business days.
3) MSA + SOW redline sequence — we typically do a single consolidated redline pass; engineering provisioning can begin once an NDA is in place and we have the SOW agreed for the POC.

Attachments included: Redwood_NDA.pdf (stub), Data handling summary (inline), DataWave_SOW_v1.pdf (stub).

DocuSign link for quick NDA signature (optional): https://www.docusign.com/example-link/abc123
HubSpot: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12345

If it helps, proposed next steps:
- Sarah / procurement: can we schedule a 30-min call next Tue Jul 13 (am PT) to walk SOW + routing?
- Alex: confirm procurement inbox and whether procurement needs a PO template included in the SOW.

Thanks — copying Rishi and Lauren to own follow-up on the SOW and technical onboarding.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@datawave.com>, Sarah Park <sarah.park@datawave.com>, procurement@datawave.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sales discovery: Legal routing & procurement next steps

Alex / Sarah — thanks for the fast turnaround. I'll own the SOW redline coordination from Redwood. A few quick operational notes: 
- We'll accept the NDA countersign or DocuSign route — whichever is fastest for you.
- For the MSA/SOW redlines, our sequence is: one consolidated redline on the MSA + SOW simultaneously, then we issue a final clean copy for signature. Expect ~3 business days for an internal Redwood legal review once we get your redlines.
- If procurement requires a PO-first flow, please share the PO template and we'll include the PO fields in the final SOW.

Next steps for scheduling: Marissa, can you lock the 30-min sync with Sarah + procurement on Tue Jul 13 9:30am PT? Alex, I'll put together a short list of the limited set of legal concessions we typically accept to speed the process.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
